primitive.relation: definitional equality: Minor X220's x220_prism3 (el_graph 6 with the nine-edge list of the 3-prism: triangles {0,1,2}, {3,4,5} and matching (0,3), (1,4), (2,5)) and x220_prism H (H IS a spanning and exact subdivision of it, subdiv_rep, whose same-side model edges - exactly the six triangle edges - have empty interiors) are Minor.foundations.prism_configurations.prism_base and prism_configuration H, with the same edge list, witness model, endpoint value test, adjacency hypothesis and no guard (six or more vertices is a consequence). It is a whole-host predicate; containment of a prism is an induced copy of such an H. The restriction has teeth (a subdivided triangle edge gives a subdivision of prism_base that is not a prism configuration). Distinct: Topological D6emb's is_prism (isomorphism to C_n x K_2, n > 2) and antiprisms; the X220/X67 thetas are not part of this family.

prism-base-graph.note: The 3-prism as el_graph 6 over the same nine-edge list, verbatim.

prism-three-path-configuration.note: Whole-host spanning/exact subdivision of the 3-prism with unsubdivided triangle edges, verbatim.
